name: stock_news_app_hermes_tool
description: Stock news and financial market aggregator with AI analysis, structured summaries, and custom tracked stock management.

tools.name: get_stock_news
tools.description: Retrieve clustered financial news, AI factual summaries, and key points for monitored stocks or markets.

verified.description: If true, returns only news cross-verified by multiple independent sources

limit.description: Maximum number of news clusters to return (1-100, default 20)

days.description: Retrieve news within the last N days (default 3)

tools.name: get_tracked_stocks
tools.description: Get current list of tracked stocks, markets, real-time prices, and latest headline summaries.

activeOnly.description: Filter by active monitoring status (default true)

tools.name: add_tracked_stock
tools.description: Add or re-activate a custom stock in the tracking pool.

nameCn.description: Chinese name or abbreviation (e.g. 宁德时代)

tools.name: trigger_news_fetch
tools.description: Trigger an immediate news fetch and clustering batch run.

skipAi.description: Skip AI summarization for faster ingestion
